```plato

    // The parallelogram with its corner and both side vectors carried through the
    // mapping. The sides are re-derived as differences of mapped corners, so an
    // affine mapping is reproduced exactly and a non-affine one is approximated by
    // the affine map through those three corners.
    Deform(g: Parallelogram2D, mapping: Function1<Point2D, Point2D>): Parallelogram2D
    {
        var origin = mapping(g.Origin);
        var a = mapping(g.Origin + g.SideA);
        var b = mapping(g.Origin + g.SideB);
        return (origin, origin.Between(a), origin.Between(b));
    }
}
```
